任何反馈将不胜感激。

  1. 扩散模型：z_image_turbo_bf16.safetensors.../ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

    • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files/diffusion_models

    • https://huggingface.co/jayn7/Z-Image-Turbo-GGUF/tree/main
      基础型号：

    • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image/tree/main/split_files/diffusion_models

  2. 文本编码器：qwen_3_4b.safetensors.../ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

    • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files/text_encoders
      GGUF 变体：

    • https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-4B-GGUF/tree/main

  3. VAE：安全张量.../ComfyUI/模型/vae/

    • https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/z_image_turbo/tree/main/split_files/vae

  • 高档型号：4x_foolhardy_Remacri.pth.../ComfyUI/models/upscale_models

    • https://huggingface.co/FacehugmanIII/4x_foolhardy_Remacri

  • 检测型号：脸_yolov9c.pt.../ComfyUI/models/ultralytics/bbox

    • https://huggingface.co/Bingsu/adetailer/blob/main/face_yolov9c.pt

    • https://github.com/facebookresearch/segment-anything#model-checkpoints

    • https://huggingface.co/alibaba-pai/Z-Image-Turbo-Fun-Controlnet-Union/tree/main

    https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Pack

  • 🟩 ComfyUI-Impact-子包（由LTDR数据)
    https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack

    https://github.com/alexopus/ComfyUI-Image-Saver

    https://github.com/willmiao/ComfyUI-Lora-Manager

  • 🟪 ComfyUI-KJNodes（由基贾伊)
    https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes

  • 🟪 ComfyUI_essentials（由立方体)
    https://github.com/cubiq/ComfyUI_essentials

⚙️ Recommended Settings

  • 涡轮步骤：6 至 10（默认设置为 9）。

  • 涡轮CFG：1.0（默认设置为 1.0）。

  • 基本步骤：25 至 50

  • 基础CFG：3.0至6.0

  • 采样器：欧拉或 res_multistep

  • 调度程序：简单

[1:1] 1024x1024
[3:4] 896x1152
[5:8] 832x1216
[9:16] 768x1344
[9:21] 640x1536

尝试并享受！
